card.name: Start of historical years
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a year in the 1100s to 1700s, in biographies and history texts. It responds after words like born, died, in, or d. giving a date.

modes.label: Space before a year
modes.description: The blank token right before a four-digit historical year after born, died, or in.
modes.example: Antonio de Herrera y Tordesillas A Spanish historian; born at Cuellar, in the province of Segovia, in<< >>1559; died at Madrid

modes.label: First digit of a year
modes.description: The leading digit 1 of a medieval or early modern year inside parentheses.
modes.example: The French called these the First Natchez War (<<1>>716), the Second Natch

card.plain: It notices that a historical year, like a birth or death date in a biography, is about to be written.
